preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in stdin.split()[:2]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in [int(a) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m] for a in line.split()]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**5 for x in [int(a) for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k] for a in line.split()])
preconditions.description: Input must satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, 1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5, and all vertex indices in edges and queries are between 1 and n (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == m + k + 2 and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m]) and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k])
preconditions.description: Input format is correct: exactly m edges and k queries, each edge and query is a pair of integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(xi) != int(yi) for xi, yi in [line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k]])
preconditions.description: Each query pair (xi, yi) has distinct vertices (xi ≠ yi).

preconditions.expression: len(set(edge for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m] for edge in [tuple(sorted((int(a), int(b)))) for a, b in [line.split()]])) == m
preconditions.description: The graph has no multiple edges (all edges are unique).

preconditions.expression: all(int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+m] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: The graph has no loops (no edge connects a vertex to itself).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join([str(int(count) % 1000000007) for count in [count_paths(xi, yi, graph) for xi, yi in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[m+2:m+2+k]]]])
postconditions.description: For each query (xi, yi), stdout contains the number of distinct simple paths from xi to yi in the vertex cactus graph, modulo 1000000007. The function count_paths(xi, yi, graph) returns the count of distinct simple paths from xi to yi, where graph is the adjacency representation of the input graph.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is a non-negative integer ≤ 10^9 (modulo 1000000007).
